# Tatas Lustre

> Tatas Lustre ("The Nub Of Hair Radiance") is a natural hair care app focused on length retention. It builds a gentle daily hair routine for each person's hair type, porosity and goals, and helps them keep the length they grow.

Website: https://tataslustre.com/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tatas_lustre
Contact: tatasradiantlustre@gmail.com
Status: coming soon on Android (Google Play). Join the waitlist on the website.

## Who it is for
- Women, men, teens (13 to 17, with a parent's okay), children (run by a parent) and hairstylists
- Natural hair: wavy, curly and coily (types 2 to 4, including 4C), and relaxed hair

## What it does
- A personal daily hair routine (moisturise, seal, scalp massage, satin at night, wash day) with gentle reminders and streaks
- A hair year calendar with wash days and weekly treatments
- An AI hair coach that answers hair questions using the person's own hair details (general hair care tips, not medical advice)
- Growth tracking with length checks and private photos, a then-and-now comparison and a hair diary
- Short lessons, step-by-step how-to guides, a hair words dictionary and games such as Myth or Fact
- Style ideas, a hair kit guide, homemade herbal oil recipes and food for healthy hair
- Friends, streaks and challenges to stay consistent
- Stylist mode: a client book, bookings and short courses for hairstylists

## Privacy
Hair photos, lengths and the hair diary are private to each person. Data is not sold and there are no ads.

## Pricing
Free to start. Some extras may be part of a Premium plan later.
